query:
select
             coalesce((select array_agg(l.id) from lists l where l.workspace_id = $1),
                      '{}'::uuid[]) as "lists!: Vec<Uuid>",
             coalesce((select array_agg(t.id) from tags t where t.workspace_id = $1),
                      '{}'::uuid[]) as "tags!: Vec<Uuid>"
